skill_name: Analyze the given set of data and summarize the feature correlations
workflow: The analysis of the given set of data shows a positive correlation between height and weight. As the height increases, the weight of the person also tends to increase. In other words, a taller person also tends to be heavier than a person who is shorter. For example, in the data set, the tallest person (180cm) has the highest weight (72kg). Similarly, the shortest person (160cm) has the lowest weight (60kg).
